children.value: > Fact From Story That message is loud and clear: The U.K. government isn’t willing to be consistent when it comes to climate crisis response policy, which, aside from capital and the support of nascent tech markets, is one of the most critical things anyone in our sector can hope for.

> > Fact From Story For entrepreneurs, innovators and businesses to thrive and unlock the economic potential that comes from creating new industries, we need a consistent approach from the government.
> > > Fact From Story All major technological innovation ultimately comes from government support at the very beginning.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Government support is essential for technological innovation.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A consistent approach from the government allows entrepreneurs, innovators, and businesses to thrive.
> Commonsense Knowledge Governments should be consistent in their policies to provide stability and predictability for businesses and citizens.
